{{Quote|In ancient times, on Corellia, Lord Nyax was what parents threatened their children with if they didn't eat their stewfruit or go to bed on time.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="ELRS" />}}
A '''stewfruit''' was an [[Diet/Legends|edible]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that was consumed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="ELRS" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] before the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Corellian [[Youngling/Legends|children]] often refused to eat their stewfruits, which prompted their [[Parent/Legends|parents]] to use the false threat of the bogeyman [[Lord Nyax]] to make them obey. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] told of parents doing so<ref name="ELRS" /> in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]],<ref name="date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]'' to [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].</ref> when he told the tale of Lord Nyax to members of the [[Walkway Collective]] resistance group.<ref name="ELRS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stewfruits were mentioned in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]'', a novel written by [[Aaron Allston]] and published in [[2002]].<ref name="ELRS" />
